title: spec: the blueprint dashboard widget has no aggregation slot, so an AI-built 「平均面试评分」 metric sums (908 instead of an average); add an optional aggregate (objectstack-ai/cloud#3607 row 2 ruling A)
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2

Filing gate: **executing a recorded ruling**. The maintainer ruled objectstack-ai/cloud#3607 row 2 **A** (record 6656298548; their selection, verbatim: 「A spec 加聚合字段（推荐）」). This card is the spec half. objectstack-ai/cloud#3607 keeps the cloud half (the designer emits it, the compile requires it), `pm:blocked` on this card.

**Owner.** The `repo:cloud` lane (`repo:cloud#3`, objectstack-ai/objectstack#30278) follows it to close. It widens a published schema (`Clause-②: yes (widening)`), so it is spec-lane work; triage routes it. Priority p2, inherited from objectstack-ai/cloud#3607.

## 维护者速读

AI 通过 MCP 搭建的仪表盘里，标题写着「平均面试评分」的组件显示的是 12 个分数的总和 908。原因是蓝图的仪表盘组件只有 `measure`，没有「聚合方式」字段，平台按字段类型自动选（数值字段求和），AI 想要平均值也无处可写。按裁决，给组件加一个可选的 `aggregate`。

## Measured

- On staging `bd085bb0` (objectstack-ai/cloud#3607 row 2, app `app.nnf5` 招聘管理), the server's own `propose_blueprint` wrote `{chart:'metric', measure:'score'}` for a widget titled 「平均面试评分」, and the dashboard summed 12 scores (908).
- The seat read `packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts:202-216` at objectstack `origin/main`. `BlueprintDashboardSchema` widgets declare `id`, `title`, `object`, `chart`, `measure`, `groupBy` and `condition`, and nothing else. `measure`'s describe says: "The aggregation is chosen automatically from the field type — a money field SUMs, a percentage/rate AVERAGEs".
- The cloud#3607 dev also measured that cloud's `defaultAggregateFor` averages only `percent`. So a plain number field can never be averaged through a blueprint (report: objectstack-ai/cloud#3607 comment 6652310415).

## The ruled design

1. An optional `aggregate: 'sum' | 'avg' | 'min' | 'max' | 'count'` on the blueprint widget, in the lenient schema and in the strict mirror the dev named. Its describe states what each value means and that `count` needs no `measure` field.
2. The `measure` describe is rewritten so it no longer tells the author the aggregation is automatic: the aggregation is what `aggregate` says.
3. ⛔ No title heuristics anywhere (option C was rejected).

## Acceptance

- Schema tests: each value is accepted; an unknown value is refused by the strict mirror; an absent value still parses (it is optional).
- The liveness ledger row for the new key, with its consumer named: objectstack-ai/cloud#3607's cloud half reads it. It is `planned` until that lands.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, with the spec-lane contract review on record.

Dedupe (issues, open and closed, 2026-11-05): `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack blueprint widget aggregate is:issue` returned 13 hits (#14302, #15449, #14298, …), none on this slot.

## Added 2026-11-05: the calendar date key (objectstack-ai/cloud#3607 row 1 residue, ruling B)

The maintainer ruled **B** on the calendar date key; the record is on objectstack-ai/cloud#3607, and their selection, verbatim, is 「B 现在加 spec 键」. It belongs to the same spec PR as the widget `aggregate`.

- **Today** (`packages/spec/src/ai/solution-blueprint.zod.ts:163`): `BlueprintViewSchema` declares `object`, `name`, `label`, `type`, `columns`, `groupBy`, `filters`, …, and has no date key. A `calendar` view therefore cannot say which date field it schedules on. Cloud binds the first declared date or datetime field and names it in the success envelope (objectstack-ai/cloud PR #3616).
- **Add:** an optional date-field key on the blueprint view, in the lenient schema and the strict mirror, meaningful for `type: 'calendar'`. Name it after the target the spec already uses, `calendar.startDateField`; the spec lane decides the exact key. Its describe states that it is ignored for other view types, or refused for them; the spec lane chooses, and the choice is stated.
- **Acceptance:** schema tests for the key on a calendar view, a strict-mirror refusal of a wrong type, and a liveness ledger row whose consumer is the objectstack-ai/cloud#3607 cloud half (`planned` until it lands).
